# Handoff: the API

The API work is finished except for the load tests. The [search proposal](../proposals/search.md) explains why the index lives in the reader's browser rather than on a server.

## What is done

Paragraph 1 of the done list. Every endpoint returns JSON, every error carries a stable code, and every request is logged with its latency. The clients retry with backoff and give up after five attempts, so nothing loops forever.

## Open questions

The rate limiter uses a token bucket per client, refilled once a second; the burst size of 40 requests came from last month's traffic and may be too generous.

Who owns the dashboards once this ships is still open.
